steps.name: 01 Home
steps.goal: Be on the home session list with the composer visible
steps.done: Home is showing and the composer can dictate a message

steps.name: 02 Agent sheet
steps.goal: Tap the button labelled Claude Code, default model, default thinking. Change. Do not tap the prompt field or the keyboard.
steps.done: The agent sheet is open and the usage ring control is on screen

steps.name: 03 Usage profiles
steps.goal: Open usage details from the ring and see each Claude profile listed with its own windows
steps.done: The usage page lists Claude 1 and Claude 2 with their own percentages, not one merged card
